evidence: CancelOrderUseCase.ts execute returns an inline literal { id: order.id, status: order.getStatus(), lines: order.lines, createdAt: order.createdAt.toISOString() }
ListOrdersByStatusUseCase.ts execute maps with the same inline literal: orders.map(order => ({ id, status: order.getStatus(), lines, createdAt: ...toISOString() }))
PlaceOrderUseCase.ts private mapToDto(order: Order): OrderDto repeats the same mapping but is private, so the other use cases cannot reuse it
UpdateOrderStatusUseCase.ts execute returns the same inline OrderDto literal

UpdateOrderStatusUseCase.ts: const validStatuses: OrderStatus[] = ['placed','paid','packed','shipped','delivered'] copies the domain OrderStatus values and validates them again before order.transitionTo(newStatus)
All files reach persistence only through the injected OrderRepository and ProductRepository ports; there is no direct DB or ORM access
parsedVerdict.reasoning:
The five files are one cohesive concern: order and stock use cases. They reach persistence only through the injected domain ports OrderRepository and ProductRepository, and they use the domain StockManager and Order methods (canBeCancelled, transitionTo). Cohesion and repository access pass.

The unit still fails because the same mapping rule is copied rather than shared. The Order→OrderDto mapping (id, status: getStatus(), lines, createdAt.toISOString()) is written out separately in CancelOrderUseCase.execute, ListOrdersByStatusUseCase.execute, PlaceOrderUseCase.mapToDto (a private method, not shared) and UpdateOrderStatusUseCase.execute.

UpdateOrderStatusUseCase also hard-codes its own list of valid statuses, validStatuses = ['placed','paid','packed','shipped','delivered']. This copies the domain OrderStatus definition, and status validity belongs to Order.transitionTo, so the check sits outside the domain abstraction. The list also leaves out 'cancelled', which shows the copy has already drifted from the domain. This finding is less certain: Order.ts is not shown, so it is inferred that OrderStatus also has 'cancelled' and that transitionTo validates statuses.

violations.message: Copies the Order→OrderDto mapping inline in execute(). The same mapping is also in ListOrdersByStatusUseCase, PlaceOrderUseCase.mapToDto and UpdateOrderStatusUseCase instead of one shared mapper.
